_doc: Camera paths for the film, one per shot. web/vite/film-scene.ts serves the local export's scene.json with one shot's
filmPath in place of the export's (scene.json?shot=<name>); nothing else in the scene changes. Keys as in scene.json:
t in seconds, position in metres (floor y = 0, eye 1.6), yaw and pitch in degrees, yaw 0 looking along -z.
Why not the export's own path: its turn point (2.955, 1.6, 0.477) stands inside Marble's hallway wall, so its look back
shows blank paper. These paths turn 0.85 m past the door centre (2.609, 1.6, 0.421), where the hallway is open.

hook.note: Looking down at the pen line across the threshold, then up into the drawn doorway.

walk.note: From the start pose to the door, over the line, into the hallway, round, and the look back. The turn is 0.85 m past the door centre, short of the hallway's far wall.

switch.note: The view near the door that the design pass judged, rendered twice: ink, then ?ink=off.

outro.note: The start pose, a slow step towards the drawn doorway.
